body.purpose: All UI, forms, tables, and dashboard copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366f1; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Surface
components.description: Default content card on dashboard pages.
components.html:
Application Status

Track your placement applications in one place.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #1F2933; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.03); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #6B7280; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Warm institutional landing with cream and gold; clean task-focused dashboards with indigo actions and Inter typography.
keyCharacteristics: Cream auth/landing surfaces with gold accents
Inter for all UI; Montserrat for marketing headings

rules.name: The Dual-Lane Rule
rules.body: Landing/auth uses cream + gold. Dashboards use white/gray + indigo actions.

rules.name: The One UI Family Rule
rules.body: Inter handles all interactive UI. Caveat never appears in admin tables or form labels.

dos: Do use indigo for primary dashboard actions
Do provide full interactive states on every component
donts: Don't use purple gradients or glassmorphism
Don't mix inconsistent button styles across roles
